description: Cross-rule interaction suite — elements triggering 2+ rules simultaneously, conflict cases, and positive multi-criteria passes. Prefix X-. collective=0 (non-collective dwelling).

elements._note_calc: POSITIVE CROSS — all rules active simultaneously. qual-R01: C24 OK. qual-R02: mc=14% ∈ [10,18] OK. geo-R01: s=400 ∈ [300,600] OK. geo-R02: 38×89 = min(h≤2700,s≤400) OK. No splice. fire-R01: rei=30 ≥ 30 OK. fire-R03: pb=12.5 ≥ 12.5 OK. All rules pass → CONFORME.

POSITIVE CROSS — qual+geo+deflection+fire simultaneously. qual-R01: C24 ≥ C18 min OK. qual-R02: mc=14% OK. qual-R03: δ=8 ≤ 3000/300=10 OK. geo-R01: s=400 OK. geo-R02: 38×89 = min(h≤2700,s≤400) OK. fire-R01: rei=30 OK. fire-R03: pb=12.5 OK. → CONFORME.

DUAL KO — qual-R01 AND qual-R02 both fail. qual-R01: C16 rank=2 < C24 rank=4 → strength_class_ok=NO. qual-R02: mc=22% > 18% → moisture_ok=NO. Both sub-checks fail → qualified=NO. needs_geometry NOT set → geo skipped. Compliance: NON_CONFORME (strength insufficient + moisture too high).
DUAL KO — qual-R01 AND qual-R03 both fail. qual-R01: C14 rank=1 < C18 rank=3 min → strength_class_ok=NO. qual-R03: δ=18 > 3000/300=10 → deflection_ok=NO. Both fail → qualified=NO → NON_CONFORME.

DUAL KO — geo-R01 AND geo-R02 both fail. geo-R01: spacing=700 > 600 max → geometry_rejection. geo-R02: h=2700, s=700 (>600) → minimum section band h≤2700 s≤600 → min 38×140. Provided 38×89 → 89 < 140 → geometry_rejection also from R02. frame_ok=NO. Compliance: NON_CONFORME (spacing > max AND section insufficient for spacing band).

DUAL KO — geo-R02 AND geo-R04 both fail. geo-R02: h=2700, s=400 → min 38×89. Provided 38×63 → depth 63 < 89 → geometry_rejection. geo-R04: has_longitudinal_splice=1 → geometry_rejection (splice on LBS). frame_ok=NO. Compliance: NON_CONFORME (section below min + longitudinal splice).

DUAL KO — geo-R01 AND geo-R04 both fail. geo-R01: spacing=250 < 300 min → geometry_rejection. geo-R04: has_longitudinal_splice=1 → geometry_rejection. frame_ok=NO. Compliance: NON_CONFORME (spacing below min + splice).

DUAL KO — fire-R01 AND fire-R03 both fail. fire-R01: rei=20 < rei_min(collective=0)=30 → rei_ok=NO → fire_rejection. fire-R03: pb=9.5 < pb_min(collective=0)=12.5 → pb_thickness_ok=NO → fire_rejection. fire_ok=NO. qual OK (C24, no moisture). geo OK (38×89 h2700 s400). Compliance: NON_CONFORME (REI insufficient + PB too thin).

DUAL KO — fire-R02 AND fire-R03 both fail. fire-R02: reaction_class=B rank=3 > 2 → lining_ok=NO → fire_rejection. fire-R03: pb=9.5 < 12.5 → pb_thickness_ok=NO → fire_rejection. Note: rei=30 would be OK (R01 passes). fire_ok=NO. Compliance: NON_CONFORME (lining class B + PB too thin).

TRIPLE KO — fire-R01 + fire-R02 + fire-R03 all fail simultaneously. fire-R01: rei=20 < 30 → rei_ok=NO. fire-R02: reaction=B rank=3 > 2 AND surface_mass=5.0 < 8.0 → lining_ok=NO (2 sub-criteria fail). fire-R03: pb=9.5 < 12.5 → pb_thickness_ok=NO. fire_ok=NO. Compliance: NON_CONFORME (all fire sub-checks fail).

CROSS AGENTS — qual KO (agent 1) AND fire KO (agent 4) simultaneously. qual-R01: C16 rank=2 < C24 rank=4 min for SP → strength_class_ok=NO → qualified=NO. fire-R01: rei=20 < 30 → rei_ok=NO → fire_ok=NO. Compliance sees qualified=NO AND fire_ok=NO → NON_CONFORME (both qualification and fire fail).

CROSS AGENTS — qual-R02 (moisture) AND fire-R01 (rei) both fail. qual-R02: mc=5% < 10% lower bound → moisture_ok=NO → qualified=NO. fire-R01: rei=20 < 30 → rei_ok=NO → fire_ok=NO. Compliance: NON_CONFORME (moisture too low + REI insufficient).

QUALIFICATION GATE — qual failure masks geometry failure. qual-R01: C16 < C24 → qualified=NO → needs_geometry NOT set by R04. geo-R02 skipped (no needs_geometry). Section 38×63 would also fail geo-R02 (min 38×89) but is never evaluated. Compliance: NON_CONFORME (qualified=NO only — geometry failure invisible behind qual gate). Demonstrates agent targeting cascade.

POSITIVE CROSS — spacing-section interaction at boundary. geo-R01: s=600 = max boundary (600 ∈ [300,600]) → OK. geo-R02: h=2700, s=600 → band h≤2700 s≤600 → min 38×140. Provided exactly 38×140 → section at exact minimum → OK. frame_ok=YES. Demonstrates that s=600 selects the wider section band and 38×140 exactly satisfies it. Compliance: CONFORME.

POSITIVE CROSS — thermal at exact R boundary. R = 195/(1000×0.030) = 6.5 m²K/W. R_min(zone A) = 6.5. 6.5 >= 6.5 → thermal_ok=YES (boundary inclusive). Compliance: CONFORME. Tests that the R >= R_min comparison uses >= (inclusive) not > (strict).

KO — Sd just below SC2 minimum. thermal-R02: Sd=17m, SC=2 → Sd_min(SC2)=18m. 17 < 18 → thermal_ok=NO (boundary−1). Compliance: NON_CONFORME (Sd one unit below minimum for SC2). Tests boundary precision on VCL thermal rule.
